newsitem.title: USA: Quintiles files for 4 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Quintiles files for 4 mln shr offering.

text.p: Quintiles Transnational Corp said on Friday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of four million shares of common stock.
Of the four million shares being offered, 1.16 million shares will be sold by the company and 2.84 million shares by selling shareholders, the company said.
Quintiles said it expects that 3.2 million of the shares will be offered in the U.S. and 800,000 of the shares will be offered outside of the U.S.
Goldman Sachs & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Smith Barney Inc, and William Blair & Company LLC will serve as managing underwriters for the proposed offering, Quintiles said.

The company's proceeds from the offering will be used for geographic expansion, addition of new services, potential acquisitions, capital expenditures, working capital and other general corporate purposes, it said.
